connector.name: Palinode
connector.registryDescription: Git-versioned markdown memory for AI agents: save, search, compact, lint, and audit.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package palinode. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the phasespace-labs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PALINODE_DIR
env.description: Path to the markdown-memory directory (e.g. ~/.palinode). Created if missing.

env.name: PALINODE_API_HOST
env.description: Host where the back-end palinode-api process is reachable

env.name: PALINODE_API_TOKEN
env.description: Optional bearer token enforced on every palinode-api request other than /health. Required when PALINODE_API_BIND_INTENT=public. Generate with: python -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))'.

env.name: PALINODE_API_TOKEN_FILE
env.description: Path to a file containing the bearer token (alternative to PALINODE_API_TOKEN; for docker-secrets style deployments)

env.name: PALINODE_MCP_HTTP_HOST
env.description: Bind host for the MCP HTTP server. Defaults to loopback; set to 0.0.0.0 only with intentional network exposure (paired with PALINODE_API_BIND_INTENT=public on the back-end).

env.name: PALINODE_MCP_HTTP_PORT
env.description: Port for the MCP HTTP server

env.name: PALINODE_API_HOST
env.description: Host where the back-end palinode-api is reachable

env.name: PALINODE_API_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token enforced by palinode-api. Required when binding non-loopback. Generate with: python -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))'.

env.name: PALINODE_API_TOKEN_FILE
env.description: Path to a file containing the bearer token (alternative to PALINODE_API_TOKEN)
